# Writing — how docs get made here

<!-- Generated by `repo-brief writing`. Edit the tool, not this file. -->

## This repo

| What | Where |
|---|---|
| Decisions | docs/project/decisions.md |
| Open work | docs/known-issues.md, docs/now.md |
| Front doors | docs/index.md, docs/now.md, docs/status.md, docs/known-issues.md, docs/reference/level-ledger.md, docs/project/decisions.md |
| Capture | docs/meta/capture/YYYY-MM-DD.md |
| Archive | archive |
| Context | `repo-brief context --brief "<query>"` (or this repo's wrapper) |

## Two layers

**The capture is evidence; the summary is the claim.** The capture holds what was
said, verbatim. The summary holds what it means for the work. If they disagree
later, the quote wins.

Neither layer is optional. A summary without a capture is an assertion nobody can
check; a capture without a summary is a transcript nobody will read.

## Capture

Append to `docs/meta/capture/YYYY-MM-DD.md`, one file per day:

```markdown
## C-YYYY-MM-DD-NN — <short title>

> "their words, exactly"

Recorded YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM. Summary: [[<doc>#<heading>]]
```

Append-only. Never edit an entry; a correction is a new entry that quotes the
correction. Number from `01` within the day. This directory is excluded from
`context` and the graph — it is quoted, not ranked.

Capture when the owner decides, rejects, prioritises, corrects you, states a
constraint, or describes how they want to work. Not for musings or thinking
aloud. A request is not a decision until it is stated as one.

## Summary

Write it where the repo already keeps that kind of statement — the decision log,
the backlog, or the status page — and follow the shape already in use. Dated
entries are append-only: never rewrite an old stance, add today's.

Link every summary from an index or backlog. An unlinked entry is an orphan, and
`repo-brief archive` will eventually call it one.

## Rules

- Never invent intent. Inference is marked "inferred" and stays out of the
  decision log.
- Never rewrite a dated entry. Stances move by adding, not by editing.
- Never commit. The owner reviews the diff and commits.
